topic: Designing Functional Polymers for Conditioning Hair Fibers
title: Designing Functional Polymers for Conditioning Hair Fibers
session_title: Rising Stars in Industry – Polymers Research (Invited Talks)
abstract: The personal care market has been experiencing revolutionary demand for sustainable alternatives to traditional synthetic materials used across market segments, particularly in rinse-off products that consumers see going down the drain. While consumer pressure is gaining momentum for sustainable materials, there is no tolerance for a decrease in performance. When consumers use a shampoo, they are expecting a certain level of cleaning performance, but also expect a level of conditioning that provides them with brushable hair, both wet and dry. Similarly, with a rinse-off conditioner, hair should feel silky and smooth, and any perception of damage should be reduced. Dow Home and Personal Care (HPC) explored sustainable alternatives that provide conditioning from both shampoo and rinse-off conditioner formats. We have explored two main pathways to increase conditioning: first, the increase of oil deposition on the surface of the hair, both natural oils and silicone emulsions; and second, the development of polysaccharide-based conditioning polymers that can provide increased combability in the absence of oils. This talk will share our journey to sustainable materials for shampoos and rinse-off conditioners, showcase our solutions for the deposition of actives and conditioning properties on hair.

topic: Rheology Ruminations: A Polymer Physicist’s Musings on Coating Flow
title: Rheology Ruminations: A Polymer Physicist’s Musings on Coating Flow
session_title: Rising Stars in Industry – Polymers Research (Invited Talks)
abstract: Rheology plays a crucial role in various aspects of coatings such as their synthesis, formulation, application, and performance assessment including their appearance, sag, and color, among other factors. In this talk, I will take you on a journey through my experiences in the coating industry as a polymer physicist. I will discuss several case studies demonstrating how we can leverage rheology to discover new design principles, provide formulation and application recommendations to accelerate product development, enhance operational efficiency, capture intellectual properties, and ultimately drive growth across various business units. Additionally, I will share my efforts to integrate new rheological capabilities, foster subject matter expertise, and facilitate academic collaborations to amplify the impact of rheology in our organization.

topic: My Generalist Career in the Specialized Field of Coating Process Development
title: My Generalist Career in the Specialized Field of Coating Process Development
session_title: Rising Stars in Industry – Polymers Research (Invited Talks)
abstract: I’ll present my career progression from undergraduate degrees in Chemical Engineering (B.Ch.E.) & Chemistry (B.S.) to today. Along the way I’ll share key developments across a broad range of projects that highlight my journey as a generalist in the specialized field of coating process research and development. I’ll highlight some unique aspects of being a process-focused engineer in a material-focused world, and how asking key questions, focusing on fundamentals, and contributing to a culture of learning, sharing, collaboration, and support has helped me achieve technical success. I also hope to share my personal experiences in navigating developing expertise without a Ph.D.

topic: Closing the Loop: Approaches to Improve Plastics Circularity
title: Closing the Loop: Approaches to Improve Plastics Circularity
session_title: Rising Stars in Industry – Polymers Research (Invited Talks)
abstract: In this presentation, approaches to improve plastics circularity will be discussed. In one case, novel high performance polyethylene resins were developed to allow for packaging downgauging. These product innovations also allow structures to be more recyclable. A second area to be discussed will be on approaches to counterbalance post-consumer recycled (PCR) deficiencies by well-controlled waste collection systems, proprietary performance boosters, and advanced processing to remove contaminants. These Dow’s REVOLOOP TM resins create a second life for plastic waste that would otherwise end up in landfills, incinerators, or as litter in oceans and the environment. Even the best post-consumer recycled (PCR) pellets are inherently inferior and can only be down-cycled or used at less than 100% of the virgin resin counterpart. REVOLOOP™ resins are the result of innovations in PCR characterization, new molecular design, and cost-effective manufacturing at a world-scale. This polyethylene (PE) PCR can be up-cycled by designing tailored performance boosters to recover the performance lost due to PCR incorporation. In my talk, I will focus on the molecular, processing, and characterization advances leading to these sustainable plastics.

topic: My Polymer Pilgrimage: From Iranian Grad Student to a Scientist in Industry
title: My Polymer Pilgrimage: From Iranian Grad Student to a Scientist in Industry
session_title: Rising Stars in Industry – Polymers Research (Invited Talks)
abstract: In this talk, I will walk you through my journey in the polymer world. Starting in Iran as a budding scientist, I navigated the world of post-doctorates and landed in industry. Through my own real life examples I will show you my best tips for securing a successful industrial career. I will demonstrate how team-work and collaboration creates synergy in your research, which helped land my first granted US patent for thermoset recycling. How un-related research topics can promote disruptive innovations, allowing me to utilize previous olefin polymerization knowledge in increasing efficiency and safety for drilling fluid mud cake cleaning. Finally, how my grad-school research on rheology and postdoc experiences on (meth)acrylate polymerizations, helped me to get my jobs at Covestro as i) polymer physicist and ii) application development scientist for automotive coatings.
